verdict.rationale: Devin can be tagged on Slack/Teams threads or Jira/Linear tickets and turn a described problem into an actionable coding session, which loosely supports turning feedback into a task, but there is no evidence of a feature that ingests raw feedback submissions and outputs a structured task with a proposed scope document (e.g., PRD-style scope, acceptance criteria). Missing for 10: dedicated feedback-intake workflow, structured task/spec templates, explicit 'proposed scope' output artifact, and any hands-on evidence this scoping behavior works reliably.
